levers.N12: (1) norm outputs y, nm int12 (cn x 16; norm window unchanged)
levers.N16: (1) norm outputs y, nm int16 via tn - 8 (window 32 -> 24: one remainder limb fewer per norm)
levers.N16cn: (1) norm outputs int16 via cn x 256 (window unchanged; cn up to 917,248 < 2^20)
levers.FP12: (2) softmax F_P 9 -> 12 (p stays two limbs to F_P 15; sh_o 9 -> 12 inside 9..=16)
levers.A12: (2) attention words q, k, v, qr, kr, o int12 (score window, PV, ao follow)
levers.A16: (2) attention words q, k, v, qr, kr, o int16
levers.S12: (2) score word s int12 + a 4096-row exp table (fits Dom::Tab; DD infeasible)
levers.SG: (3) per-channel-group SiLU, registry members: 0 planes; one public group column in SC_FZC and SC_TAB
levers.SI12: (3) SiLU input int12 (4096-row act table inside Dom::Tab; gate shift - 4)
levers.RH3: (3) SiLU output 4 bits finer (table values) -> product remainder three bytes
levers.H24: (3) product output h int24 (third limb) -> down input + 8 bits
levers.RES: (4) residual x, x1, x2 int24 (+ norm window + 8, isqrt four limbs)

stacks.LOW12: (c2) + norm int16 (tn route) + F_P 12 + attention words int12 + per-group SiLU + SiLU input int12 (product remainder unchanged)
stacks.LOW16: LOW12 with the attention words int16
stacks.MIN12: (c2) + norm int16 (tn route) + F_P 12 + attention words int12 + per-group SiLU + SiLU input int12 + SiLU output 4 bits finer (product three bytes)
stacks.MIN16: MIN12 with the attention words int16 (cheaper at T128, dearer at T512)
stacks.WIDE: MIN16 + h int24 + score word int12 (non-DD only)
stacks.WIDE_DD: MIN16 + h int24 (the widest that keeps DD)
stacks.WIDE_RES: WIDE_DD + residual int24 (tn - 8 serves both: norm window back to 32)
